input.sql: SELECT AVG(oxygen_count) as avg_oxygen FROM ( SELECT m.molecule_id, SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'o' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as oxygen_count FROM molecule m LEFT JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id WHERE m.molecule_id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT b.molecule_id FROM bond b WHERE b.bond_type = '-' ) GROUP BY m.molecule_id )

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) as total_single_bonded_molecules, SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'o' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as total_oxygen_atoms FROM molecule m LEFT JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id WHERE m.molecule_id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT b.molecule_id FROM bond b WHERE b.bond_type = '-' )
